农夫市集很容易让人一边逛一边买，回家才发现冰箱放不下、这一周也煮不了那么多。第一: It's easy to buy as you browse a farmers market, then get home to find there isn't enough fridge space or time to cook it all. On your first visit, narrow the goal: shop for two meals and choose one unfamiliar ingredient. At San Francisco's Ferry Plaza Farmers Market, the useful skill is choosing, asking, and getting food home—not learning every stall in one trip.
先确认逛的是哪一个市场、哪一天: Confirm which market you're visiting and on which day
从运营方 Foodwise 的 Visitor Info 进入，核对当天市集、时: Start with market operator Foodwise's Visitor Info page to confirm that day's market, hours, and location. Ferry Plaza Farmers Market is outside the Ferry Building; the shops inside have different hours. Vendors may also change by market and day. An older photo doesn't guarantee the same produce or prepared food is available today.
约朋友时指定一个容易辨认的集合点，并说清先吃东西还是先购物。买菜后的目的地最好是: When meeting friends, choose an easy-to-recognize meeting point and decide whether to eat or shop first. Home is the best next destination after buying groceries. If you also want an afternoon of exhibitions or shopping, buy fewer chilled items or leave grocery shopping until last. Don't leave food waiting in the car while you attend another event.
用两顿饭倒推份量，给新鲜感留一小格: Work backward from two meals, with a little room for something new
先看冰箱已有食材，写下两顿饭需要补的蔬菜、主食或蛋白质来源。: Check what's already in your fridge, then list the vegetables, staples, or protein you need for two meals.
给总花费和能拎回家的重量设自己的上限，再留一个尝新名额。: Set your own spending and carrying-weight limits, with room to try one new item.
带可重复使用的袋子；买易腐食材时另带保冷袋与冰袋，生食原料分开放。: Bring reusable bags. For perishables, bring an insulated bag and ice packs, and keep raw ingredients separate.
准备一种备用支付方式，手机充好电；普通宠物另作照看安排。: Have a backup payment method and a charged phone. Arrange other care for ordinary pet animals.
清单不必写死品种，可以写“今晚炒一盘的蔬菜”或“明天早餐的水果”。到摊位先问计价: Your list can describe a use rather than a specific variety: "vegetables for tonight's stir-fry" or "fruit for tomorrow's breakfast." At the stall, ask whether prices are per pound, box, or bunch, and confirm weight and total before paying. If you're unsure how to prepare something, ask whether it is best raw or cooked and how to store it. That is more useful than buying a big bag just because it looks colorful.
先走一圈，支付与试吃都先问: Browse once, then ask about payment and samples
Foodwise 说明多数摊主接受信用卡或非接触支付，“多数”不等于每家都能刷手: Foodwise says most vendors accept credit cards or contactless payment. “Most” does not mean every stall accepts your phone. Read the signs or ask first. The Info Booth also offers market tokens; check how they work and any fees. Ask permission before sampling, selecting produce, or taking close-up photos, and respect the vendor's normal service flow.
该市场的认证农贸区域不允许普通宠物进入，服务动物例外；不能因为场地在户外就默认可: Regular pets are not allowed in this market's certified farmers market area; service animals are an exception. An outdoor setting does not automatically mean dogs are welcome. For another Bay Area market, check its own operator rather than assuming Ferry Plaza's payment and entry rules apply. Keep bags close in crowds and leave room in the aisle when stopping to chat.
买完先顾保冷，再决定要不要继续逛: Keep food cool before deciding to explore more
按 FDA 户外食物指引，需冷藏食品运输时应放入有冰或冰袋的保冷容器，维持四摄氏: FDA outdoor food guidance recommends transporting refrigerated food in an insulated container with ice or ice packs, keeping it around 4°C or below. Perishables such as meat, eggs, and seafood should generally stay out no more than two hours, reduced to one hour when the temperature exceeds 90°F. These limits apply to food needing temperature control; they don't mean every whole, uncut fruit needs the same countdown.
回家花十分钟，让食材真的进餐桌: Spend ten minutes at home helping the groceries reach your table
先安置需要冷藏的食材，再整理当天和之后才会吃的东西。FDA 建议蔬果与生肉、禽类: Put refrigerated items away first, then sort what you'll eat today and later. FDA recommends keeping produce in separate bags from raw meat, poultry, and seafood. Rinse produce under running water before eating or preparing it; don't use soap or dish detergent. Follow package directions for prewashed or ready-to-eat items. Keeping one or two soon-to-eat items visible saves more than filling the fridge and forgetting them.

找一个先逛再买的市集搭子: Find a market companion who likes to browse before buying
